back.target: for it, for that (also: in favour of it; in return)
back.example: Thanks for that, that was really nice.

note: The hint "one word" is useful because it rules out "für das"; since this is the word's only card, its other common meanings ("in favour of it", as in "Ich bin dafür", and "in return") are not taught, so a second card could be worth adding later.
